We need propose retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We need to output JSON route with type mol root, children reaction nodes etc. Need to select appropriate template IDs. We need to find templates matching each step: likely step1: amide formation (carboxylic acid to amide). In target, we have C(=O)N attached to an aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). So retrosynthesis: break amide to carboxylic acid and amine. So precursor: aromatic aldehyde? Actually amide from carboxylic acid + amine. So precursor1: acid: /C=C/C(=O) (the unsaturated acid) attached to phenyl sulfonyl phenyl? Wait structure: phenyl-sulfonyl-phenyl-CH=CH-CO-NH-Ph-NH2? Actually Nc3ccccc3N is an aniline with NH2 para? The SMILES: ...C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N. So amide carbonyl attached to an aniline (anilide) which also has an NH2 substituent (para? not specified). So retrosynthesis: break amide to acid (alpha,beta-unsaturated acid) and aniline (with NH2). So step1: amide formation.

Step2: The unsaturated acid could be formed via Doebner modification from aromatic aldehyde and malonic acid. So break double bond and carboxyl to aldehyde and malonic acid? Actually forward Doebner: aldehyde + malonic acid -> alpha,beta-unsaturated acid (with decarboxylation). So retrosynthesis: break unsaturated acid to aromatic aldehyde and malonic acid. So step2: break C=C and C=O? The product is unsaturated acid attached to phenyl sulfonyl phenyl? Actually the unsaturated acid is attached to phenyl sulfonyl phenyl via para? The unsaturated acid is attached to phenyl ring (c2ccc(... )cc2). So the aldehyde precursor would be that phenyl ring with aldehyde substituent (para to sulfonyl). So step2: break to aromatic aldehyde (c2ccc(CHO)cc2) and malonic acid.

Step3: Sulfonamide formation: the sulfonyl chloride reacting with an amine to give sulfonamide. In target, we have NS(=O)(=O) attached to phenyl ring (c1ccc...). So retrosynthesis: break sulfonamide to sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonic acid?) and amine (the aniline with methyl). The amine is the tolyl amine (p-toluidine). So step3: break sulfonamide to tolyl amine (p-toluidine) and sulfonyl chloride (maybe p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride? Actually the sulfonyl group attached to phenyl ring c2... So sulfonyl chloride would be ClSO2-Ph? Wait the sulfonyl group is attached to phenyl ring c2ccc... So the sulfonyl chloride is p-tolylsulfonyl chloride? Actually the sulfonyl group is attached to phenyl ring (c2ccc...). The sulfonamide nitrogen attached to tolyl ring (c1ccc...). So sulfonyl chloride would be ClSO2-Ph (the phenyl that is attached to sulfonyl). So step3: break to sulfonyl chloride (ClSO2-Ph) and amine (p-toluidine). So we need template IDs for each reaction. We can search template catalog by criteria.

We need to find template IDs for amide formation (carboxylic acid + amine -> amide). functional_groups_broken: carboxylic_acid (since broken), functional_groups_formed: amide? Not sure list includes amide. Might be "amide". Let's search.
